questions.q: Why did major United States stock indexes like the S&P 500 and Nasdaq end lower?
o: Surging oil prices lifted expectations for a September rate hike.
The federal government cut funding for quantum computing firms.
SpaceX was removed completely from the Nasdaq 100 index.
Passive index funds stopped tracking technology stocks.
questions.e: Surging oil prices drove expectations for monetary tightening, raising rate fears that pressure equity valuations. The government actually increased funding for quantum firms, and SpaceX's weighting was increased rather than removed.

questions.q: How does an increase in the Nasdaq 100 weighting for SpaceX affect passive index funds?
o: It forces portfolio managers to rebalance holdings and buy more SpaceX shares.
It allows index funds to stop buying shares in all other technology companies.
It removes the need for any portfolio rebalancing across the index.
It eliminates concentration risk entirely within the benchmark.
questions.e: When an index increases a company's weighting, funds tracking it must mechanically buy more of those shares to match the new proportion. This actually increases concentration risk rather than eliminating it.
